inv.desc_es:
INVERSIÓN CALLE SANGENJO, MADRID.

Local en rentabilidad en la zona de Herrera Oria, concretamente en la calle Sangenjo, Madrid. Ubicado dentro de un entorno residencial y comercial muy consolidado con un gran tránsito peatonal y rodado.

A 5 minutos andando del C. C. La Vaguada, a 200 metros del metro Herrera Oria, a 10 minutos de la estación de cercanías Ramón y Cajal, y a menos de 50 metros de diferentes líneas de autobús.

El local está rodeado por todo tipo de servicios, colegios, tiendas, supermercados, negocios de hostelería, etc.

Dispone aproximadamente de 158 m2 distribuidos todos ellos en planta calle, más dos plazas de garaje en el mismo edificio.

Estupenda fachada.

Local alquilado desde el año 2011 a un inquilino serio y solvente, el cual cuenta con una amplia experiencia en el sector y una clientela fija a lo largo de todos estos años. Este dato, puede dar cierta tranquilidad al inversor de la permanencia en el local por parte del inquilino.

Rentabilidad del 5,2%.

inv.desc_en:
INVESTMENT SANGENJO STREET, MADRID.

Profitable commercial property in the Herrera Oria area, specifically on Sangenjo Street, Madrid. Located within a well-established residential and commercial environment with high pedestrian and vehicular traffic.

A 5-minute walk from La Vaguada Shopping Center, 200 meters from Herrera Oria metro station, 10 minutes from Ramón y Cajal commuter train station, and less than 50 meters from various bus lines.

The premises are surrounded by all types of services, schools, shops, supermarkets, hospitality businesses, etc.

It has approximately 158 m2, all distributed on the ground floor, plus two garage spaces in the same building.

Excellent facade.

The property has been rented since 2011 to a serious and solvent tenant, who has extensive experience in the sector and a loyal customer base over all these years. This fact can provide some reassurance to the investor regarding the tenant's continued occupancy of the premises.

CONTRACT VALID UNTIL JULY 2033.

5.2% profitability.

Take advantage of this investment opportunity and benefit from a return that no bank will offer you. For more information, please contact us and we will be happy to assist you. iG1095

At inverGeo, we are specialists in profitable commercial properties. We have profitable commercial properties throughout Spain.
For more information, visit our website.
